BJP MLA Files FIR Against Son-in-Law for Multiple Marriages

Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) MLA Gyan Tiwari has filed a First Information Report (FIR) against his son-in-law, Anuj Trivedi, in Sitapur, Uttar Pradesh. Tiwari alleges that Trivedi concealed his marital history and engaged in fraudulent marriages with multiple women, reportedly up to 25. The MLA claims Trivedi provided false information about his family and business before the marriage. The FIR was filed after Tiwari reportedly discovered Trivedi's alleged past through social media.
